name: vidsum
description: Agent skill to summarize or transcribe video and audio: a file on your Mac or a link (YouTube, Bilibili, Douyin, Xiaohongshu, TikTok, Instagram, X, ...). Claude runs the vidsum command-line tool and returns a timestamped transcript, SRT/VTT, key-frame notes, on-screen text and a summary with timecode citations. Models run locally on Apple Silicon; experimental cloud mode for OpenAI-compatible APIs.
